name: Carlos Gomez
learned: Carlos Gomez is a poet who loves to explore his inner thoughts and feelings. He is always looking for new ways to express himself.
currently: Carlos Gomez is working on a collection of poetry that explores the beauty of the natural world. He is also attending creative writing workshops to hone his skills.
lifestyle: Carlos Gomez goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 7am, eats dinner around 5pm.
daily_req: wake up and complete the morning routine at 13:00 am
f_daily_schedule: Carlos is waking up and completing his morning routine (showering, brushing teeth, getting dressed) (asleep)
Carlos is eating a late lunch and reviewing his poetry drafts from the morning
Carlos is attending a creative writing workshop to hone his skills and explore new poetic forms
Carlos is still at the creative writing workshop, participating in a group critique session and taking notes on feedback for his nature-themed poems
Carlos is eating dinner and then heading to his desk to revise his nature-themed poems based on the workshop feedback
Carlos is revising his nature-themed poems at his desk, incorporating the feedback from the workshop and experimenting with new imagery
Carlos is taking a break from revising to go for a walk in the nearby park, observing the evening light on the trees and jotting down new sensory details for his nature poems

Carlos is returning from his park walk, sitting at his desk, and transcribing the new sensory notes he jotted down into his poetry manuscript, then beginning to draft a new poem inspired by the evening light

Carlos is continuing to draft his new poem inspired by the evening light, now refining the second stanza and experimenting with a more rhythmic, flowing meter to capture the quiet movement of the trees
Carlos is finishing the final stanza of his new poem, then setting aside his notebook and preparing for bed, turning off his desk lamp and heading to the bathroom to brush his teeth
